name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - § 49 - Am 126
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 49. Underlines the need to critically examine the role that the LIFE programme plays in financially supporting activist organisations lobbying for climate policies and the European Green Deal; notes the new guidelines by the Commission on grant agreements under the LIFE programme and recalls the fact that the need for stricter controls on funding is vital;
